prologue.awakening: [Awakening] Morning light pierces the capital obelisk. Pioneer {PLAYER_NAME} ({RACE_ID}) opens their eyes in {START_LOCATION}...
prologue.environment: [Observation] The streets of the nameless fortress awaken. The rune obelisk hums with faint azure mana while distant forges clang.
prologue.inspect_obelisk: [Obelisk] Ancient Kalar celestial oaths glow along the obelisk shaft, sharpening your perception.
prologue.first_encounter: [Encounter] A veteran fortress guard approaches briskly: 'Destiny guides you, {PLAYER_NAME}! Take this recruit loadout, including a {INITIAL_EQUIPMENT}.'
prologue.completed: [Departure] The guard salutes and returns to post. The prologue concludes as the Kalar continent unfolds before you!
prologue.elf_grove_awaken: [Sanctuary Awakening] Emerald dawn filters through evergreen boughs. Elven pioneer {PLAYER_NAME} touches the World Tree seed...
prologue.elf_grove_depart: [Sanctuary Departure] Silver horns sound across the grove as the barrier fades. Grasping {INITIAL_EQUIPMENT}, you step into the mortal realm!
